notes.title: BETA version will be published this month!!
notes.notes:
[p]The first [b]BETA version of [i]The Simple Balance[/i][/b] will be available later this month!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42006725/d5b77e0edb7412cdf2fc383d6aae05e9865bb8cf.png"][/img]

notes.title: First demo available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

it took some time but finally we made it and can present you a first short DEMO!!! 
We would love to see you play it and give us your thoughts and feedback about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42006725/8f8d7fdb280c0dfe7d602d898e435e832c71e5a1.jpg[/img]

You can choose from a Windows, Linux and Mac version of the demo.  Find the demo at the bottom of the page that you reach when you follow this link: 

[url=https://silence-is-a-lie.itch.io/the-simple-balance]https://silence-is-a-lie.itch.io/the-simple-balance[/url]

Don't be irritated, we have renamed the game to "The Simple Balance" some time ago. All social media channels now also are named like this. So please download, play, give feedback and follow. You really help us to make this game better!

Thank you and take care, yours,
Kai
